limitations: Serialized root transforms, collider flags and numeric GameObject layers are retained separately from runtime posture overrides and activation.
RootBone=Bip001, HeadTop=Head and PlayerCollider=Collider follow unpatched native lookup strings. Ambiguous lookup names reject admission. Runtime dictionary mutations remain unobserved.
The selected role prefabs contain no serialized SkinnedMeshRenderer. Native InitPrototyle adds it; runtime dressing/model choices and skin assembly require additional source evidence.

Default-controller and explicitly selected clips are decoded; other clip objects and unsupported records remain in byte-identical source bundles. Animator arbitration, opaque motion channels, animation events and source frame/fixed timing are not activated.
This package establishes source extraction integrity and diagnostic rest/track poses, not original-runtime rendering, collision or movement parity.
